blocks.content: **ほしい** expresses desire for a *thing* : a noun, not an action. It is an い-adjective and conjugates the same way. The object is always marked with が.

lines: [Object] が **ほしくないです**    (don't want something)
[Object] が **ほしかったです**    (wanted something)

left.label: たい : action
left.description: Attaches to a verb stem. Expresses the desire to *do* something.

right.label: ほしい : object
right.description: Follows a noun with が. Expresses the desire to *have* something.
right.example_jp: 新しいカメラがほしいです。

rows.japanese: 新しいカメラがほしいです。
今は何もほしくないです。
rows.romaji: Ima wa nani mo hoshikunai desu.
rows.english: I don't want anything right now.

rows.japanese: 子どもの頃、犬がほしかったです。
rows.romaji: Kodomo no koro, inu ga hoshikatta desu.
rows.english: When I was a child, I wanted a dog.

blocks.content: ほしい carries the same register restriction as たい : use it for your own desires only. For someone else wanting something, say ほしがっている (seems to want).
